Librogame.title: Deep State
Librogame.author: Luca Mulazzani

Changes.Change: Adapted for this app: the structure, the rules and parts of the text were changed or removed to work with its engine
Translated into English from the original Italian
Added sounds and background music, delivered together with the book

Librogame.ContentWarnings: Abduction and coercive interrogation. The questions are deliberately intrusive and cover sexual history, voting and family relationships. This is satire: there is no violence on the page, only an apparatus that treats you as a case to be processed.
Librogame.Blurb:
You are an ordinary citizen, a student, an office worker, you choose. You are walking down the street; a group of individuals with their faces covered by balaclavas gets out of a van and abducts you. You are now tied up, in a garage.
These are the questions you must answer. You may lie, if you find it useful: nobody will check. But at the end you will be asked how many times you did.

Variable.name: Denied ever having spied on anyone

Page.Text:
You are an ordinary citizen, a student, an office worker, you choose. Choose now the State you live in; better one you know well.
You are walking down the street; a group of individuals with their faces covered by balaclavas gets out of a van and abducts you. You are now tied up, in a garage.
These are the questions you must answer; you may lie, if you find it useful.
Full name:
Mother's maiden name:
Age:

Choice.text: You take a few years off

Page.Text: Age at first sexual intercourse:

Choice.text: You give a more comfortable age

Page.Text: Age of the person with whom you had your first sexual intercourse:

Choice.text: You give a more prudent age

Page.Text: Do these questions bother you? Why? Relax. We are only calibrating the system.
Have you ever conspired against the State? Against the parties? Against the church? Against your parents? Your maternal uncles? Your schoolteachers?

Choice.text: You admit to the maternal uncles

Page.Text: Perhaps you did it only, or also, or above all, preferably but not necessarily, in thought? In group thought? Without thinking it? Without meaning to?
Who did you vote for in the last election? Are you ashamed of it?

Choice.text: You say so, and yes, you are a little ashamed

Page.Text: Would you like a lawyer? Do you think there has been a case of mistaken identity? Who do you think we should have picked up instead of you? Give three names, which we will check:

Choice.text: You name a friend of yours
You give three names out of the phone book

Page.Text: How did you form a political conscience? Through frequenting socially committed groups? Playing table football? On TikTok? At the barber's/hairdresser's/dental hygienist's/financial adviser's/yoga instructor's?

Choice.text: You tell the truth: at the barber's
You say: through socially committed groups

Page.Text: We forgot to ask you whether you have a political conscience: do you?
Do you believe in free will? Why?

Choice.text: No, and you don't really think so

Page.Text: Do you believe in any form of supernatural/paranormal/subnormal/abnormal power?
Do you fear that this power, even though you don't believe in it, and perhaps above all because you don't believe in it, might punish you for what you have done in life?

Choice.text: Yes, you fear it a little

Page.Text: Do you think we are the good ones or the bad ones? And you?

Choice.text: You are the bad ones, I am one of the good ones
You are not sure you are one of the good ones

Page.Text: List three public figures you respect and would like to imitate?
Do you really believe you could imitate them?

Choice.text: You say yes, but you don't believe it

Page.Text: That others could imitate them?
Do these people really exist?

Choice.text: You say yes, but you made them up

Page.Text: Are you tired of answering these questions?

Have you understood what the point of these questions is? Would you prefer different questions? For example? "Which football team do you support?" "Is trap music really music?" "Who will be at the next Eurovision Song Contest (ESG)?" "Why are countries that are not European invited?" "Why did nobody care about the ESG at all until ten years ago?"

Choice.text: No, but you say you have

Page.Text: Do you think a great worldwide conspiracy is under way at this moment? Is it possible that you are on the right side of the conspiracy?

Choice.text: You answer, and somehow you have lied
You answer, and you have not lied

Page.Text: Do you respect your father's political opinions?

Choice.text: You say yes to close the subject

Page.Text: Do you ever feel spied on? By whom? By your workmates? By your partner? The same one you had your first sexual intercourse with? By the network? By parties you cannot identify?

Choice.text: Yes, by parties you cannot identify

Page.Text: Are you more uncomfortable among friends or among enemies?
Would you feel able to give us the names of three enemies?

Choice.text: You say you have no enemies

Page.Text: Would you accept our help against your enemies? Have you thought it over? Some opportunities do not come twice in a lifetime.
Do you think you have ever missed an important train in your life? Were you distracted/asleep/late/in the toilet? Did someone steal your seat or deceive you or wink at you?

Choice.text: Yes, you did miss a train

Page.Text: Is the questionnaire printed too small? Are you tired of answering these questions?
Let us suppose a conspiracy is under way: what size would it be? Global? National? Domestic? Confined to your block of flats?

Choice.text: Confined to the block of flats

Page.Text: Have you ever had trouble with your neighbours? What kind? Renovation work? Building grants? Parking arrangements? The gathering of the communal figs?

Choice.text: The gathering of the communal figs

Page.Text: Do you know what the tragedy of the commons is?
Which frightens you more, artificial intelligence or human stupidity?
Have you ever spied on anyone? Ever told on a classmate who was copying? Ever revealed a friend's escapades, their mistakes, the things they were ashamed of?

Choice.text: Never, not once in your life

Page.Text: Do you not feel yourself, for that reason, the author of a conspiracy?
Would you be willing to fight for something you consider very important? To fight literally, with weapons, to kill somebody?
Would you be willing to work for us? Even though you do not know who we are, above all because you do not know?

Choice.text: Yes, you would work for them
No — but you are thinking about it

Page.Text: Do you think we will let you go now? That we will report you/kill you/kiss you (like Judas)? That we will wink at you?

Choice.text: Yes, you think they will let you go

Page.Text: Have you lied to any of the previous questions? We are done; perhaps.

We have finished, you can go back to your life and start doing again what you did before, pretending to be free. Perhaps at some moment during the interrogation you glimpsed the truth, but it is too inconvenient and too complicated for you to change. Ask no questions, sleep soundly, watch the ESG.
